programs.notes: CBACT01C COPYs CVACT01Y in WORKING-STORAGE (line 89), making ACCOUNT-RECORD/ACCT-ID available. The program reads ACCTFILE-FILE sequentially (READ INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD, line 166), displays all ACCOUNT-RECORD fields individually (para 1100), then fans ACCT-ID out to four separate output records: OUT-ACCT-REC (flat sequential file), ARR-ARRAY-REC (array output file), and both VBR variable-length records (VB1-ACCT-ID, VB2-ACCT-ID). ACCT-ID is never modified — it is always a source, never a target.

ACCT-ID is used as a STRING source operand (part of a multi-line STRING statement starting line 485) to embed the account ID in transaction description TRAN-DESC: STRING 'Int. for a/c ', ACCT-ID DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO TRAN-DESC. This is a read of ACCT-ID from ACCOUNT-RECORD (populated by the READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD at line 373).

hits.note: The READ at lines 394-398 reads XREF-FILE INTO CARD-XREF-RECORD (from CVACT03Y), populating XREF-ACCT-ID indirectly. XREF-ACCT-ID itself is not named in procedure code; the access is structural via CARD-XREF-RECORD. However, ACCT-ID's value drives the lookup key FD-XREF-ACCT-ID used in that READ, tying the two together.

newly_discovered_aliases.name: FD-TRANCAT-ACCT-ID

READ TCATBAL-FILE INTO TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD at line 326 means FD-TRANCAT-ACCT-ID and TRANCAT-ACCT-ID (from CVTRA01Y) co-locate on the same physical record. Confirmed by READ-INTO alias rule.

programs.notes: CBACT04C is the most complex program in this group. It COPYs CVTRA01Y (TRANCAT-ACCT-ID at line 97), CVACT03Y (XREF-ACCT-ID at line 102), and CVACT01Y (ACCT-ID at line 112). The interest-calculation loop reads TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD sequentially; on each account boundary (line 194 COMPARE), it propagates TRANCAT-ACCT-ID into three targets: WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM (boundary tracking), FD-ACCT-ID (random account lookup key), and FD-XREF-ACCT-ID (random xref lookup key). After the account is found, ACCT-ID from ACCOUNT-RECORD is used to build a transaction description string (line 486). The program also REWRITEs ACCOUNT-RECORD (line 356) after updating interest balances, making it a WRITER of the account record containing ACCT-ID, though ACCT-ID itself is not individually named in the REWRITE statement. Line 207 is a full-line comment (col 7 = '*') and is correctly excluded.

hits.note: ACCT-ID (from CVACT01Y via FD ACCOUNT-INPUT COPY at line 78) is declared as the VSAM primary RECORD KEY for ACCOUNT-INPUT. Every sequential READ of ACCOUNT-INPUT updates ACCT-ID as the key field.

ACCT-ID from ACCOUNT-RECORD (populated by READ ACCOUNT-INPUT at line 329) is copied into EXP-ACCT-ID (PIC 9(11)) in EXPORT-ACCOUNT-DATA section of EXPORT-RECORD (defined in CVEXPORT). EXP-ACCT-ID is a newly confirmed alias.

XREF-ACCT-ID from CARD-XREF-RECORD (CVACT03Y, populated by READ XREF-INPUT at line 393) is copied into EXP-XREF-ACCT-ID (PIC 9(11) COMP) in EXPORT-CARD-XREF-DATA section. EXP-XREF-ACCT-ID is a newly confirmed alias.

CARD-ACCT-ID from CARD-RECORD (CVACT02Y, populated by READ CARD-INPUT at line 513) is copied into EXP-CARD-ACCT-ID (PIC 9(11) COMP) in EXPORT-CARD-DATA section. EXP-CARD-ACCT-ID is a newly confirmed alias.

programs.notes: CBEXPORT COPYs CVACT01Y for FD ACCOUNT-INPUT (line 78, bringing ACCT-ID/ACCOUNT-RECORD), CVACT03Y for FD XREF-INPUT (line 81, bringing XREF-ACCT-ID/CARD-XREF-RECORD), CVACT02Y for FD CARD-INPUT (line 87, bringing CARD-ACCT-ID/CARD-RECORD), and CVEXPORT in WORKING-STORAGE (line 96, bringing the export layout with EXP-ACCT-ID, EXP-XREF-ACCT-ID, EXP-CARD-ACCT-ID). All three source-side account-ID aliases are named directly and individually MOVEd into corresponding export fields. ACCT-ID is also named as the FILE-CONTROL RECORD KEY at line 44. This program is a write-only export path — all three account-ID variants are moved into EXPORT-RECORD and written to EXPFILE. The CVEXPORT export fields use COMP storage (binary) while their sources are plain PIC 9(11); the MOVE will succeed in COBOL but downstream readers of the export file must account for the COMP encoding.
